desc: Realize that the process is equivalent to finding the maximal interval containing K that can be absorbed.
The O(N) solution uses two passes (left-to-right and right-to-left) with a stack to find the maximal absorbable blocks.
Implement the left-to-right pass: stack of (value, sum). For each i, while stack top value < A[i], pop and add sum. Push (A[i], cur_sum). Store left_sum[i] = cur_sum.
Implement the right-to-left pass: same logic, store right_sum[i].
Ensure handling of large N and values (use Python int, recursion limit if needed).
